answer.text:
Gross profit margin = Gross profit ÷ Net sales × 100  
= $494.777 million ÷ $1,409.281 million × 100  
= **35.1%** (rounded to one decimal place).

The filing also reports the 2024 gross profit margin as 35.1%. (Accession **0001739566-25-000053**, Item 7, chunk **2**)
